decisions.meetings: There was no customer Meetings route. The meetings and visits for a request come from the saved commercial report read client-side inside that request's Room, not from the request detail, so combining them across requests would be a new multi-read path. The Meetings page lists the person's requests (the same list the Requests page reads, with the same session proof) and opens each where its meetings and visits are. One list of all meetings says Coming soon as plain text.
decisions.search: The board's header search has no backend that answers it under a customer's role, so it is left out (rule 3). Search stays where lists are.
decisions.honesty: Plain text with a Coming soon tag, announced as unavailable (aria-disabled), never a link or a button: Chat on WhatsApp (no owner-configured number exists), Report a Problem, Text Size, Stronger Colours, Less Movement, and Help on WhatsApp in the sidebar. Plan and Billing is a link only where customer billing is on. Company Profile follows the chosen workspace and is Coming soon with none. Mark All Read is real: it uses the existing single-item read call for each unread item, then reads the list again.
decisions.phone: Below 640 px the language and help menus are inside the avatar menu so the header row fits at 320 px; the notifications bell and the compact New Request stay in the row (the bell exists today, dropping it would lose it). At 420 px and narrower New Request is the icon alone with its name kept for assistive technology.
decisions.needsYou: Unread invitations (team, contributor, programme), assigned tasks and quotes sent are Needs You; other unread items are Updates; anything read is Earlier.
decisions.retargetedTests: tests/integration/ux-one-workspace-switcher.test.ts now checks the switcher in the avatar menu (names the current workspace, keeps the section, Manage Workspaces) and that the sidebar and header row carry none; the 16 px chevron check went with the card it described. tests/e2e/verification/revamp-s2/customer-shell.spec.ts replaces the CX PR 1 cases about the left drawer and the account menu at the foot of the bar with the new design, keeping the case ids and every property (keyboard, Escape and focus return, unclipped menus, Listen start and stop, names and addresses); customer-home.spec.ts looks for the one filled action in the sidebar. Nothing was weakened or skipped.
decisions.listen: Listen to This Page in the Help menu uses its own small speech hook rather than editing the shared corner dock; the corner dock is unchanged and is hidden on customer pages because the Help menu replaces it there.
